signIn.description: The account of this Rondyr installation.

passwordReset.description: Enter the address of your account. If an account uses it, Rondyr emails it a link to choose a new password.

passwordReset.noProvider: This server does not send email, so it cannot reset a password. Ask the person who runs it.

operations.title: Status
operations.unavailable: The processing status is unavailable. Try again.

stuck.title: Stuck submissions
stuck.description: The Cron stopped publishing these submissions after 12 attempts. Their messages are stored. Once the cause is fixed, retry them one by one.

setup.description: An organization has its own inbox, forms and destinations.

business.label: Business of the organization
business.hint: Optional. The filter uses it to judge whether a message relates to your business.

quarantined.title: Nothing to review
quarantined.note: Messages that the filter sets aside appear here until you decide on them.

accepted.title: No messages
accepted.note: Messages accepted by the filter or by you appear here.

archived.title: No messages
archived.note: Messages that you archive appear here.

all.title: No messages received
all.note: Messages sent from your forms arrive here. The address of each form is in Forms.

empty.title: No messages from {{name}}
empty.others_zero: The other forms have none here either.
empty.others_one: The other forms have {{count}} message here.
empty.others_many: The other forms have {{count}} messages here.
empty.others_other: The other forms have {{count}} messages here.

reader.label: Open message
reader.analyzing: The filter is analyzing this message. Refresh the list to see the result.

detail.loadFailed: Could not load the full message. Long fields are cut short.

reader.waiting_zero: The filter set no message aside.

reader.waiting_many: {{count}} messages wait for your decision. Open one in the list.
reader.waiting_other: {{count}} messages wait for your decision. Open one in the list.

problems.notSaved: The decision could not be saved. Try again.
problems.alreadyHandledRefresh: This message was already handled. Refresh the list to see its status.
problems.classificationQuotaReached: The daily classification quota of this organization is used up, so the message stays here. Try again after midnight UTC, or raise the limit in Settings → Daily quotas.

delete.title: Delete this message?
delete.description: The message, its deliveries and their attempts are deleted for good. Rondyr keeps only a line saying who deleted which message and when.
delete.failed: The message could not be deleted. Try again.

problems.noLongerFailed: This delivery is no longer failed. The list is refreshed.
problems.retryNotSaved: The retry could not be saved. Try again.

forms.label: Forms of the organization

empty.title: No forms
empty.note: A form gives you a submission address to put on your site.

forms.none: This organization has no form yet. Create one in Forms.
forms.name: Form name

address.title: Submission address
address.active: The address to put in the action attribute of your form, or to call with POST.
address.suspended: This form refuses new messages. Received messages stay in the inbox.

details.title: Name and business
details.noBusiness: No business described. The relevance of messages is not evaluated.
details.new: The form gets a submission address when it is created. The address never changes.

redirect.title: Redirect after submission
redirect.confirmationPage: After a submission from an HTML form, the visitor sees the Rondyr confirmation page. $t(inbox.forms.redirect.origin)
redirect.successUrl: After a submission from an HTML form, the visitor sees {{url}}. $t(inbox.forms.redirect.origin)
redirect.origin: The origin of the redirect URL must be in the allowed origins of the form.

refusals.invalid-url: Enter a full URL, for example https://www.example.com/thanks.
refusals.not-https: The URL must start with https://.
refusals.credentials: Remove the username and password from the URL.
refusals.origin-not-listed: First add the origin of this URL to the allowed origins of the form.

honeypot.title: Honeypot field
honeypot.instructions: Add a text field with this name to your form, hidden with CSS, with tabindex="-1" and autocomplete="off". Visitors leave it empty. A message that fills it goes to review without analysis.
honeypot.name: Honeypot field name

turnstile.title: Turnstile
turnstile.description: Use the site key and secret key from your Cloudflare Turnstile widget.

key.checking: Checking the stored secret key with Cloudflare…
key.working: Cloudflare accepts the stored secret key.
key.refused: Cloudflare no longer recognizes the stored secret key. Rondyr can’t verify Turnstile tokens, so it sends messages that carry one to classification without the check. Copy the secret key from the widget’s settings in the Cloudflare dashboard, then save both keys again.
key.unreadable: Rondyr can’t decrypt the stored secret key, which happens when RONDYR_SECRETS_KEY changes. It can’t verify Turnstile tokens, so it sends messages that carry one to classification without the check. Save both keys again.
key.unchecked: Couldn’t check the stored secret key because Cloudflare didn’t answer. Reload the page to try again.
key.requestFailed: Couldn’t check the stored secret key. Reload the page to try again.

turnstile.embed: Paste this HTML inside your form. Load the script only once per page.
turnstile.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy. Select and copy the HTML above.
turnstile.secretsKeyMissing: Set RONDYR_SECRETS_KEY on the Worker to enable Turnstile.
turnstile.secretKeyRefused: Cloudflare doesn’t recognize this secret key. Copy it again from the widget’s settings in the Cloudflare dashboard.
turnstile.siteverifyUnavailable: Cloudflare couldn’t check the secret key, so nothing was saved. Try again in a moment.

suspension.title: Suspension
suspension.description: A suspended form refuses new messages with status 403. Received messages, destinations and the submission address are kept.

problems.notAdded: The form could not be added. Check the fields and try again.
problems.notChanged: The form could not be changed. Check the fields and try again.
problems.statusNotChanged: The status could not be changed. Try again.
problems.redirectNotSaved: The redirect could not be saved. Try again.
problems.honeypotNotSaved: The honeypot field could not be saved. Check the name and try again.

domains.description: Declare up to {{limit}} domains for this organization. The classifier checks whether a submitted email address uses one of these domains or a subdomain.
domains.invalid: Enter a lowercase domain name such as example.com, without a scheme or path.
domains.limit: This organization already has {{limit}} domains. Remove one before adding another.
domains.loadFailed: Could not load the organization’s domains.
domains.addFailed: Could not add the domain. Try again.
domains.removeFailed: Could not remove the domain. Try again.

apiTokens.description: Use API tokens to read this inbox and resolve quarantined messages from another application.
apiTokens.name: Token name
apiTokens.invalidName: Enter a name of up to 100 characters.
apiTokens.limit: This organization can have up to {{limit}} active tokens. Revoke one to create another.
apiTokens.issued: Copy this token now. Rondyr only shows it once.
apiTokens.copyFailed: Could not copy the token. Select the token text to copy it.
apiTokens.confirmDescription: Requests using {{name}} (ending in {{suffix}}) will stop working immediately.

quotas.description: Limits apply across all forms in this organization and reset at midnight UTC.
quotas.junkHint: Messages that fill the honeypot field, fail Turnstile or repeat earlier ones are quarantined and count here, not against the submission limit. Their daily limit is the same number. Once it’s reached, Rondyr refuses them until midnight UTC and still accepts other messages.

policy.description: {{classifier}} classifies submissions for this organization. Custom settings apply to new classification runs.

hints.probableSpam: A message with a spam score at or above this value goes to review as probable spam.
hints.ambiguous: A message with a spam score at or above this value but below the probable spam threshold goes to review; this value cannot exceed that threshold.
hints.solicitation: A message with a sales outreach score above this value goes to review.
hints.lowRelevance: A message with a relevance score below this value goes to review, or is accepted with the Off-topic label if you accept off-topic submissions.

policy.escalation: Use a second model for ambiguous submissions
policy.escalationHint: {{model}} gives ambiguous submissions a second spam score. The sales outreach and low relevance rules still apply.
policy.escalationUnavailable: This deployment has no second model, so ambiguous submissions go to review.
policy.invalid: Check that the thresholds are between 0 and 1 and that ambiguous spam is at or below probable spam.
policy.saveFailed: Could not save the classification settings. Try again.
policy.loadFailed: Could not load the classification settings.

origins.label: Allowed origins of the form {{name}}
origins.description: The sites whose pages can submit this form from a browser. An empty list allows all sites.
origins.loadFailed: Could not load the allowed origins.
origins.empty: No origins: all sites are allowed.
origins.inUse: The redirect of this form points to this origin. Remove the redirect first.

refusals.invalid-origin: Enter a full origin, for example https://www.example.com.
refusals.wildcard: Wildcards are not accepted. Add each origin.
refusals.not-https: The origin must start with https://. Only localhost and loopback addresses accept http://.
refusals.credentials: Remove the username and password from the origin.
refusals.not-an-origin: Remove the path, the query and the fragment. Keep the scheme, the host and the port.

problems.notAdded: The origin could not be added. Try again.
problems.notRemoved: The origin could not be removed. Try again.

destinations.notSaved: The change could not be saved. Try again.

test.limited: This destination already got 3 tests this minute. Wait a minute and try again.
test.limitUnavailable: Rondyr could not check the test limit of this destination, so it sent nothing. Try again in a minute.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.description: Each accepted message is sent in a POST request to these URLs, signed with the webhook secret.

refusals.invalid-url: This is not a valid URL.

refusals.custom-port: Use the default HTTPS port, without a port number.
refusals.local-hostname: This hostname points to a local network.
refusals.reserved-address: This IP address is private or reserved.

emails.label: Email destinations of the form {{name}}
emails.title: Emails
emails.description: Each accepted message is sent as plain text to the recipients of each destination, in the language of the destination.
emails.loadFailed: Could not load the email destinations.
emails.empty: No email destinations for this form.
emails.notAdded: The email destination could not be added. Try again.
emails.missingProvider: Email sending is not configured on this Worker. It needs RESEND_API_KEY and RONDYR_EMAIL_FROM.

refusals.no-recipients: Enter at least one email address.
refusals.too-many-recipients: A destination accepts at most {{max}} addresses.
refusals.invalid-address: An address is not valid. Enter bare addresses, such as team@example.com, without a name or angle brackets.

emails.confirmationNote: Rondyr emails each new address a link to confirm it, once for the organization. Messages and tests go to confirmed addresses only.
emails.resendLabel: Send the confirmation email to {{address}} again

resend.confirmed: {{address}} is already confirmed. Refresh the page to see it.
resend.limit: {{address}} already got 3 confirmation emails today. Try again tomorrow.
resend.noProvider: This server does not send email, so the confirmation cannot be sent.
resend.failed: The confirmation email to {{address}} could not be sent. Try again.

members.title: Members
members.description: A reviewer reads the inbox and the deliveries, then accepts or archives messages. An admin also manages forms, destinations, members and settings.
members.confirmDescription: {{name}} ({{email}}) loses access to this organization at once. The account stays, and an admin can invite it again.
members.confirmTokens_one: This also revokes the API token that this member created. An integration that uses it, such as a website, stops reading the inbox.
members.confirmTokens_many: This also revokes the {{count}} API tokens that this member created. An integration that uses one of them, such as a website, stops reading the inbox.
members.confirmTokens_other: This also revokes the {{count}} API tokens that this member created. An integration that uses one of them, such as a website, stops reading the inbox.
members.stepDownDescription: You will keep reading and reviewing messages, but you will no longer manage forms, destinations, members or settings. Only another admin can make you an admin again.
members.inviteDescription: The invitation link works once, for 7 days. Rondyr emails it when this server sends email, and you can copy it in every case.
members.rolesHint: Reviewers read messages and decide on them. Admins can do everything, including inviting and removing members.
members.copyFailed: The link could not be copied. Select it and copy it by hand.

emails.sent: Invitation emailed to {{email}}. The link below is shown only now.
emails.no-provider: This server does not send email. Copy this link and send it to {{email}}: it is shown only now.
emails.limit-reached: {{email}} already got 3 invitation emails in the last 24 hours. Copy this link and send it yourself: it is shown only now.
emails.failed: The email to {{email}} could not be sent. Copy this link and send it yourself: it is shown only now.

retention.description: Rondyr deletes the messages older than these periods, counted from their reception, once an hour. Leave a field empty to keep the messages without limit. Deleted messages can't be recovered from the dashboard.

retention.hint: From 1 to {{maximum}} days, or empty to keep them.

outcomes.invalid: Enter a whole number of days from 1 to 3,650, or leave the field empty.
outcomes.failed: The retention periods could not be saved. Try again.
